name: Refresh breaks the page
why: The app routes in JavaScript and the host has no fallback rule, so every page but home is a 404 on refresh or as a shared link.
report: If I click from the home page into another page of the app and then load that same address directly, I get the host's 404 error page instead of the page.

name: No not-found page
why: A mistyped or stale link drops the visitor on the host's raw error page with no way back.
report: If I type an address that does not exist, like /this-page-does-not-exist, I get the raw error page of the host instead of the app's own not-found page with a way back home.

name: Back button is broken
why: Navigation replaces history or re-routes, so back leaves the app or lands on the wrong page.
report: If I go from the home page into another page of the app and press the browser back button, I do not land back on the home page.

name: Builder placeholder branding left in
why: The generated title, description or share image was never replaced.
report: The browser tab title or the visible page still shows builder placeholder text such as 'Lovable', 'Vite + React' or 'vite_react_shadcn_ts' instead of the app's own name.

name: Buttons and links that do nothing
why: Generated UI ships with handlers that were never wired up.
report: At least one main navigation link or primary button on the home page does nothing at all when clicked: no navigation, no dialog, no visible change.

name: Protected page open to everyone
why: The auth guard only hides the menu link; the route itself renders for anyone.
report: If I open a private-looking address such as /dashboard or /admin directly without signing in, I see the page's content instead of being sent to a sign-in screen.

name: Placeholder content in production
why: Sample text and fake data from generation were shipped as real content.
report: The home page shows obvious placeholder content such as 'Lorem ipsum', 'example.com', 'John Doe' or 'Your text here'.

name: Broken images
why: Image paths point at files that were never uploaded or at expired generated URLs.
report: At least one image on the home page fails to load and shows a broken image icon or an empty box where a picture should be.

name: Legal and footer links go nowhere
why: Footer links are generated as '#' and never filled in.
report: A footer link such as Privacy, Terms or Contact goes nowhere: clicking it stays on the same page or leads to an error page.

name: Blank or crashed page
why: An unhandled error or missing data leaves a route as a white screen or raw error text.
report: At least one page reachable from the main navigation shows a blank white screen, a spinner that never ends, or raw error text instead of content.
